summary: Return the FULL nested tracking plan for the active project's main branch (events with attached properties/sources/destinations, property library, sources, destinations, routing, mappings, metrics). This can be large — for a cheap first read use get_overview, then get_plan/get_event when you need full detail. Pass summary=true for counts only.

params.name: summary
params.doc: If true, return counts instead of the full plan.

returns: { plan, branch, categories[], events[], properties{event[],user[],group[],system[]}, sources[], destinations[], metrics[] } | { plan, counts }

summary: Concise, reasoning-ready summary of the plan for the active branch — the cheap first read. Returns counts, per-category event counts, lightweight event/source/destination rows, and a health snapshot (validation findings by severity + is_publishable) WITHOUT the full nested payload. Reach for get_plan or get_event only when you need full detail.
returns: { plan{name}, branch{name,is_main}, counts{events,event_properties,user_properties,sources,destinations,metrics,categories,bundles}, categories[{name,event_count}], events[{name,category,property_count,source_count,destination_count}], sources[{name,platform_type,destination_count}], destinations[{name,platform}], health{findings_by_severity{warning,info},is_publishable} }

summary: Return a single event with its attached properties and destination mappings. Look up by name or event_id.

params.name: name
params.doc: Event name to look up. Provide name or event_id.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: Event UUID to look up. Provide event_id or name.

returns: { id, name, display_name, description, category_id, tags, trigger_type, trigger_config, purpose, properties[], destinations[] } | { error, error_type:'not_found', message }

summary: Validate the working draft and return a findings report (rule-based checks: casing, regex, required properties, type consistency, PII flagging, plus structural checks). Read-only. is_publishable is true when there are no error-severity findings.
returns: { findings[{ rule_id, severity, code, message, entity_type, entity_id, suggested_fix }], rules[{ id, rule_type, config, severity, enabled, scope_category_id }], counts{ error, warning, info }, is_publishable }

summary: Run a tracking-plan coverage audit and persist the result as an AuditRun + AuditFindings. Calls validate_plan internally, maps findings to AuditFinding rows (TP 'error' → 'critical' severity for correct scoring), and computes a coverage score (100 minus weighted penalties: critical=10, warning=5, info=1). The saved run appears in /project/:slug/audits under the 'tracking_plan_coverage' domain.

params.name: branch
params.doc: Branch id or name to audit. Defaults to main.

returns: { ok: true, audit_run_id, score, critical, warning, info, counts } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Return all dashboard cards for the active project — a lightweight list for the metric-link picker. Each card includes its parent dashboard title and platform.
returns: { cards: [{ id, title, dashboard_title, platform }] }

summary: Create an event on the working draft (main branch). Validated against the schema.

params.name: name
params.doc: Unique event name on the branch.

params.name: display_name
params.doc: Human-friendly label.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: UUID of an existing category.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Create an event AND attach its properties in one atomic call. Takes every create_event field plus a `properties` list. For each property: if property_id is given it is attached; otherwise an existing event-kind library property with that name is reused (find-or-create), creating it from data_type/is_pii/is_list when absent. Saves the get-then-attach round-trips of create_event + N attach_property calls.

params.name: name
params.doc: Unique event name on the branch.

params.name: display_name
params.doc: Human-friendly label.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: UUID of an existing category.

params.name: properties
params.doc: Properties to attach. Each item: { name, data_type?, required?, example?, is_pii?, is_list?, property_id? }. With property_id, that library property is attached; otherwise an event-kind property is found-by-name or created (data_type defaults to 'string').

returns: { ok: true, id, name, attached:[{ name, property_id, created }], skipped:[...] } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Update fields on an existing event. Only supplied fields are changed.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event to update.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete an event from the working draft. Also removes all property attachments and destination mappings for that event.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event to delete.

returns: { ok: true, deleted } | { error, error_type, message }

params.name: sources

summary: Dry-run ingest of an externally-discovered event list (GA4 / GTM / Adobe / dataLayer). NORMALIZES each incoming event name to the plan's casing (default snake_case), fuzzy-dedups against existing events (e.g. 'Add To Cart' matches add_to_cart), and diffs into new / updated / unchanged / conflicts. WRITES NOTHING — deterministic and idempotent. Pair with reconcile_apply to commit the approved subset. Feed this the events you discovered via your own analytics connector MCPs; Fluxito does the normalization, dedup, and gap-diff.

params.name: events
params.doc: Discovered events. Each item: { name, display_name?, description?, category?, trigger?, source?, properties?:[{ name, data_type?, required?, example?, is_pii?, is_list? }] }.

params.name: options
params.doc: { normalize_casing?: bool (default true), casing?: snake_case|camelCase|Title (default snake_case), match_strategy?: exact|fuzzy (default fuzzy) }.

returns: { new[], updated[{name,event_id,changes}], unchanged[{name}], conflicts[{reason,...}], normalized_names{input:resolved}, summary{new,updated,unchanged,conflicts} }

summary: Apply a reconcile_preview result: for each event, follow the caller's per-event decision (create | update | skip). Creates events with their properties (find-or-create event-kind properties), updates changed fields on matched events, and logs one activity row per applied event. Runs on the active/target branch and commits atomically. Events with no decision default to skip.

params.name: events
params.doc: The same normalized event objects from reconcile_preview (or your edited subset).

params.name: decisions
params.doc: Map of normalized event name -> 'create' | 'update' | 'skip'. Missing entries default to 'skip'.

params.name: options
params.doc: Same options object as reconcile_preview (must match what was previewed: normalize_casing, casing, match_strategy).

returns: { ok: true, created[{name,id}], updated[{name,id}], skipped[{name,reason}], errors[{name,error}] }
